about_short_description.short_description: Metreecs helps retailers plan and allocate products efficiently with AI forecasting, driving sales and reducing waste.

product.name: AI-Driven Demand Forecasting Platform
product.description: A platform that uses AI to predict product demand, helping retailers optimize inventory allocation, replenishment, and purchasing decisions.

product.name: Inventory Rebalancing Tool
product.description: An AI-powered tool that suggests inventory allocation adjustments across stores and channels to prevent stockouts and reduce overstock.

product.name: Automated Reordering and Purchasing Recommendations
product.description: A service that anticipates top-selling products and provides recommendations on what, where, and how much to reorder within budget constraints.

product.name: AI-Powered Analytics and Performance Tracking
product.description: An analytics tool that tracks product performance, sales by channel, and inventory levels using AI to provide actionable insights.

product.name: Never Out of Stock (NooS) Solution
product.description: A solution that maintains optimal inventory levels to meet actual customer demand and prevent stockouts.

product.name: Just in Time Inventory Management
product.description: A solution that suggests steps to reduce on-hand inventory and forecast reordering needs to streamline operations.
